payload.claim: `discover_specs`'s docstring (lines 184-187) promises the filename order 'resolves the same way on every machine,' but `sorted(directory.glob("*.md"))` sorts `Path` objects, not filename strings. `PurePath.__lt__` compares `_str_normcase`, which CPython lower-cases on the Windows flavour (`ntpath`) but leaves case-sensitive on the Posix flavour — so two specs whose filenames differ only in case would tie-break oppositely on a Windows host versus a Posix one. The gates can't see this because every gate ran on one machine. In practice this is unlikely to bite since the cell runtime (`apple/container`) constrains the control plane to Posix hosts, which is why this is a note rather than a concern: sorting by `path.name` (a plain string) would make the documented guarantee actually true rather than incidentally true.
